title: ChiliSMP-VN server
description: Chilibu's SMP server, join now! Eco-chill and eco-pvp, super fun, a Vietnamese server!
body:
☀️ **ChiliSMP** is a fresh, modern {1.21.x - new} Minecraft Survival Server designed specifically for economy lovers and chill players. Features a **75% Hardcore Economy** system where your hard work truly pays off. Fully cross-play supported—both Java and Bedrock players can join and build the ultimate empire together!

🌱 **Why ChiliSMP?**

* **True Economy (75%):** Farm, trade, and build a massive automated estate to climb the richest leaderboard.
* **Pure Co-op Survival:** No toxic elements. Claim your town and build with friends without griefing worries.
* **Ultimate Optimization:** Clean backend, optimized threads, guaranteeing an absolute lag-free experience for everyone.
* **Cross-Platform:** PC and Mobile play together seamlessly in one massive, beautiful world.

Perfect for spending those long summer nights relaxing, grinding, and chatting with an incredibly fun, welcoming community. Active Staff and 24/7 dedicated support.

💬 **Join our community, grab the server IP, and find your teammate now:**
